name: mapping
description: Generic, portable map-data tooling — reusable across any map project (advertising, hiking, travel). Skills: geocode (address list -> coordinates, multi-format), tileset (prep pipeline), mapbox (Studio API), crosswalk (GEOID/FSA/CBG), location-scrape. References the Mapbox pattern skills by name; does not fork them. Advertising vendors live in the adtech plugin; BigQuery stays as loose Klever infra skills.
